items.statement: The submission uses the supplied 8OBAF acid and 1:1 8OBAF:CNPy pair with neutral singlet specifications and preserves the noncovalent O-H...N relation.
items.expected: Both named systems are explicitly identified and their charge, multiplicity, connectivity and complex interaction are documented.

items.statement: The reported geometries and dipoles are supported by convergence and stationary-point or equivalently justified validation evidence.
items.expected: Per-system validation records are present and tied to the reported structures and dipoles.

items.statement: The computed dipole of 8OBAF is compared with the source-reported acid value.
The computed dipole of 8OBAF:CNPy is compared with the source-reported complex value.
